title: In vivo passive trunk load-relaxation: initial moment and 16-min moment drop at 30-100% of flexion-relaxation angle (standing frame, pelvis rotated)
quantity: passive extension moment about L5/S1 during load-relaxation

notes: Single-study group; quantity definitions differ between studies in this category, so cross-study pooling was not done.
